# EdgeReco

> EdgeReco is an open-source, browser-first ecommerce search and recommendation engine
> built by GainRatio. After a one-time sync of a signed, content-addressed catalog
> bundle, product search, hybrid ranking, and session-aware recommendations execute
> entirely inside the shopper's browser via SQLite WASM and OPFS — with zero per-query
> backend calls and zero shopper-behavior egress. The live storefront showcases
> EdgeReco on a 100,000-product catalog across 12 departments.

## Canonical URLs (edge-reco.com)

- [Live Storefront](https://edge-reco.com/): Interactive 100,000-product browser search and recommendation showcase.
- [On-Device Search & Recommendations](https://edge-reco.com/on-device-search): Architecture overview of browser-executed FTS5 + vector retrieval with zero backend latency.
- [EdgeProc Substrate](https://edge-reco.com/edgeproc): Entity disambiguation and architecture of the underlying `gainratio/edge-proc` local-first search substrate.
- [GitHub Directory](https://edge-reco.com/github): Canonical index of EdgeReco, EdgeProc, `edgeproc-core`, and sibling GainRatio repositories.
- [FAQ](https://edge-reco.com/faq): Technical answers on bundle verification, Nimbus demo catalog, offline operation, and privacy guarantees.

## Key Architectural Invariants

1. **Fail-closed cryptographic bundle verification**: Every catalog release is content-addressed with SHA-256 chunks and signed with an Ed25519 manifest key (`/public.key`). Any signature mismatch, chunk digest failure, or rollback attempt aborts activation before SQLite opens the catalog.
2. **Single-worker SQLite WASM + OPFS persistence**: In the browser, one Web Worker owns the SQLite WASM database backed by Origin Private File System (OPFS) for durable offline reloads, falling back transparently to in-memory SQLite when OPFS is unavailable or held by a second tab.
3. **Single-SQL hybrid retrieval & vector quantization**: Lexical search runs on SQLite FTS5 `bm25()`, semantic vector search runs on `sqlite-vector` with on-device `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` query embeddings via ONNX Runtime Web (supporting compact vector compression including TurboQuant / int8 quantization), and Reciprocal Rank Fusion (`RRF`, `k=60`) merges both signals in a single local SQL query.
4. **Session-aware reranking with zero PII/event egress**: Clicks, product views, favorites, and cart additions stay strictly inside the shopper's local SQLite database. `Content-Security-Policy: connect-src 'self'` enforces at the browser boundary that zero search queries or interaction events leave the device.

## Related GainRatio Open-Source Stack

All repositories live under https://github.com/gainratio and are indexed at https://open-source.gainratio.com/:

- [EdgeProc (`gainratio/edge-proc`)](https://github.com/gainratio/edge-proc): Python local-first substrate for Ed25519-signed FastCDC bundles, deterministic task routing, and local FAISS + BM25 RRF retrieval.
- [`edgeproc-core` (`gainratio/edgeproc-core`)](https://github.com/gainratio/edgeproc-core): Multi-tenant vector-partition routing protocol and RFC 9457 error taxonomy on PyPI (`edgeproc-core`).
- [`@edgeproc/browser`](https://browser.gainratio.com/): Browser runtime for Ed25519-verified bundle sync into OPFS-backed SQLite WASM.
- [AML-Filter (`gainratio/aml-filter`)](https://github.com/gainratio/aml-filter): Zero-egress browser sanctions screening across 31,566 OFAC SDN, EU, UN, and UK OFSI entities — live at https://aml-filter.com/
- [Privacy Core (`gainratio/privacy-core`)](https://github.com/gainratio/privacy-core): Deterministic in-browser PII redaction, Luhn/IBAN/SSN checksum validation, and type-checked LLM Egress Guard (`https://privacy.gainratio.com/`).
- [Assay / Avow (`gainratio/assay`)](https://github.com/gainratio/assay): Ed25519 signing and offline verification over RFC 8785 canonical JSON (`avow` on PyPI, `@gainratio/avow` on npm, docs at `https://avow.gainratio.com/`).
- [AlmaMesh (`gainratio/almamesh`)](https://github.com/gainratio/almamesh): Full Python Vedic astronomy & Kundli engine running in-browser via Pyodide + JPL DE421 ephemeris — live at https://almamesh.com/
- [GainRatio CI (`gainratio/ci`)](https://github.com/gainratio/ci): SHA-pinned reusable GitHub Actions workflows and composite actions for OIDC publishing, secret scanning, and Pages deployment.
